judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The terse handover of a key and an Ogre chief is Nox-shaped, but the stakes laid out so neatly (grain, starving winter), the crafted simile 'greater calamity than locusts and hail together' and the tidy three-page structure feel like a modern pastiche. It is also too clean, with none of Westwood's rough punctuation.
